title: 2.5 Adaptation and Mitigation Strategies to Climate Change
description: UNFCCC response strategies, adaptation types, Ethiopian practices and mitigation measures. Medium level.

questions.question: How does the IPCC define adaptation to climate change?
options: Ethiopia can adopt modern efficient technologies directly instead of high-emission pathways
Adjustments in ecological, social or economic systems in response to actual or expected stimuli a
A vent is a pipe-like opening that builds a cone; a fissure is a narrow crack that builds a plateau
Natural causes can work through all three external mechanisms while humans mainly use two
questions.correctAnswer: Adjustments in ecological, social or economic systems in response to actual or expected stimuli a

questions.question: What is the purpose of adaptation adjustments?
options: The landmasses were connected so the reptile could disperse
Emissions trading, the CDM, sinks accounting and compliance
To moderate potential damages or benefit from opportunities
Oceans absorb more heat from the atmosphere and fuel storms
questions.correctAnswer: To moderate potential damages or benefit from opportunities

questions.question: What distinguishes private from public adaptation?
options: Whether it is motivated by households and companies or by government
It introduced moving continents that plate tectonics later explained
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
questions.correctAnswer: Whether it is motivated by households and companies or by government

questions.question: What is autonomous adaptation?
options: Systems that accumulate and store greenhouse gases, such as forests and oceans
Sudden ground shaking caused by rock masses changing position below the surface
A change in the mean or variability of climate persisting for decades or longer
Changes systems undergo in response to climate regardless of any policy or plan
questions.correctAnswer: Changes systems undergo in response to climate regardless of any policy or plan

questions.question: How does mitigation reduce warming?
options: They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions
By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases
They have larger amplitude and travel along the surface
It links crustal movement to the formation of landforms
questions.correctAnswer: By lowering emissions of heat-trapping greenhouse gases

questions.question: What are sinks in climate mitigation?
options: Changes in incoming solar radiation, atmospheric composition and Earth surface
They interact at boundaries to form features such as mountains and earthquakes
Systems that accumulate and store greenhouse gases, such as forests and oceans
Sudden ground shaking caused by rock masses changing position below the surface
questions.correctAnswer: Systems that accumulate and store greenhouse gases, such as forests and oceans

questions.question: Which activity is a mitigation measure?
options: Replacing coal power with wind energy
Climate change happens only in winter
Changing the crop planting date
Building terraces on farms
questions.correctAnswer: Replacing coal power with wind energy

questions.question: Why has adaptation become an urgent policy priority?
options: It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
Whether it is motivated by households and companies or by government
Sensitivity to the issue grew after the IPCC Third Assessment Report
questions.correctAnswer: Sensitivity to the issue grew after the IPCC Third Assessment Report

questions.question: At which levels are climate responses needed?
options: Snow increases surface temperature directly
It included ministers as well as scientists
Longer growing seasons and earlier snowmelt
Local, regional, national and global levels
questions.correctAnswer: Local, regional, national and global levels

questions.question: Which Ethiopian practice involves changing the time farmers sow seeds?
options: Water harvesting
Changing crop planting date
By eliminating all diseases
A new theory of ocean tides
